name: Themed names for AI empires
description: AI empires (never the player or pirates) take race-flavoured names: the empire itself at game start (by race and government), its new fleets (a warlike race's "Iron Talon Armada", a mystic race's "Veil of Quiet Stars") instead of "1st Fleet", and its newly settled colonies. The names are picked deterministically (no random draws), so the galaxy plays out otherwise the same.

flags.name: themedNamesEmpires
flags.label: Empire names
flags.description: At game start every AI empire is renamed by its race and government (no two empires share a name).

flags.name: themedNamesFleets
flags.label: Fleet names
flags.description: New AI fleets and strike forces get race-themed names instead of "Nth Fleet" / "Nth Strike Force".

flags.name: themedNamesColonies
flags.label: Colony names
flags.description: When an AI colony ship settles an empty world, the new colony takes a race-themed name (worlds whose population joins keep their names).
